notes: Bundled solutions are a handwritten scan (pages 11-20, answers in blue pen); keys and worked answers transcribed from them. Section I 5 marks, Section II 27 marks, total 32 (Q6 3, Q7 3, Q8 8, Q9 8, Q10 5). Q6, Q7 have only part (a) with sub-parts; kept as printed (relabel step will shift). Q8 c(i) carries the 2 marks printed beside c) and c(ii) 1 mark. Tables in Q4, Q7 and the Q9(b) fill-in table are stored as cropped figures. Possible issues in the solutions: Q7 a(ii) handwritten as '150 000 - 14340' (should be 15 000; transcribed as 15000); Q9 c alternative handwritten as $12447.57 while Q9 b side-note gives $12447.58 (a 1-cent inconsistency, 2647.58 written); Q9 d marking is unclear (handwritten $9918.23 or $12447.58, with a typed note 'Or $7408.96 if interest was calculated correctly in part c'); the recurrence A_0 = 2450 means the balance after 3 quarters would arguably be A_2 = $7408.96. Q8 a(ii) solution circles the house and top-right vertex as odd. Q4 option printed '$2.6730' (the present value factor, not a dollar amount) and '6%p.a.' kept as printed. Solution scan text layer is OCR garbage so solutions were read from the page images.
